```{r setup-mascot_popup_menu, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot_popup_menu-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_popup_menu")
```

### From a click to your server

```{r mascot_popup_menu-flow, echo = FALSE}
guide_flow(
  guide_step("The visitor picks", htmltools::div(htmltools::tags$strong("Finish review"))),
  guide_step(htmltools::tags$code("input$helper_menu"), htmltools::div('becomes "finish"')),
  guide_step("Your", htmltools::tags$code("observeEvent()"), htmltools::div("decides")),
  guide_step(htmltools::tags$code("update_mascot()"), htmltools::div("answers"))
)
```

```{r mascot_popup_menu-last, echo = FALSE}
if (in_studio()) htmltools::div(class = "pg-live",
  htmltools::tags$span(class = "pg-muted", "Last choice here: "), shiny::textOutput("menu_last", inline = TRUE))
```

### Long status

The menu opens from the mascot's position on the screen and falls back to the opposite side when the
chosen side has no room. A long status makes the mascot taller, so choose a corner, then open the live
mascot's menu to see where it lands.

```{r mascot_popup_menu-try, echo = FALSE}
if (in_studio()) htmltools::tagList(
  try_button("menu_long_status", "top-right", "Try top corner with long status"),
  try_button("menu_long_status", "bottom-right", "Try bottom corner with long status")
)
```

### Your server code for these items

```{r mascot_popup_menu-code, echo = FALSE}
if (in_studio()) htmltools::div(class = "pg-code-wrap", code_output("menu_code"), copy_button("menu_code"))
```

For an item named `finish` and labelled "Finish review", the server can answer like this:

```r
shiny::observeEvent(input$helper_menu, {
  switch(input$helper_menu,
    finish = mascot::update_mascot("helper", mood = "happy")
  )
})
```

<div class="pg-callout">

<strong>input$&lt;id&gt;_menu vs input$&lt;id&gt;_click.</strong>
Menus never set `input$<id>_click`; only `mascot_action()` does. Choosing an item sets
`input$<id>_menu` to the chosen item's id. Opening and closing the menu sends no Shiny input.

</div>

<div class="pg-callout">

<strong>Supply menu items when setting options.</strong>
Setting `disabled`, `direction`, `label` or `tooltip` requires `items`.
To remove the click behaviour, pass `click = mascot_popup_menu()` to `update_mascot()`.

</div>

<div class="pg-callout">

<strong>Keyboard.</strong>
Tab to the mascot's menu button, then Enter or Space opens it; arrow keys move between items; Escape closes it.

</div>
